name: Whiskey
description: Guidelines for traveling with whiskey in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Whiskey is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Standard bottles must go in checked baggage.

checkedBag.reason: Whiskey under 70% ABV (140 proof) is allowed in checked baggage. Limit of 5 liters per passenger for alcohol between 24% and 70% ABV.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring whiskey on a plane?

travelTips: Whiskey is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Standard bottles must go in checked baggage.

faq.question: Is whiskey allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Whiskey is restricted in carry-on luggage. Whiskey is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Standard bottles must go in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can you pack whiskey in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Whiskey is allowed in checked bags. Whiskey under 70% ABV (140 proof) is allowed in checked baggage. Limit of 5 liters per passenger for alcohol between 24% and 70% ABV.
